import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

cars = data['cars']['data']
dimensions = data['cars']['dimensions']
categories = data['cars']['categories']

    'SUV': '#2E5A88',
    'Sedan': '#C44E34',
    'Electric': '#55A868'
}

type_zorder = {'SUV': 2, 'Sedan': 3, 'Electric': 4}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 10))

n_dims = len(dimensions)

    y = [car[dim] for dim in dimensions]
    color = type_colors[car['type']]
    z = type_zorder[car['type']]
    ax.plot(x, y, color=color, alpha=0.55, linewidth=1.4, zorder=z)

    y = [car[dim] for dim in dimensions]
    color = type_colors[car['type']]
    ax.scatter(x, y, color=color, s=18, zorder=5)

    ax.axvline(x=idx, color='lightgray', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.set_xticks([])

ax.set_title('Car Model Comparison Across Seven Performance Dimensions\nby Vehicle Type', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.set_facecolor('#f8f9fa')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#ffffff')

ax.text(0.5, -0.09, 'price_score = affordability (higher = more affordable)', transform=ax.transAxes, ha='center', fontsize=8, color='gray')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
